answer: Because the terrace stake is held until the onyx settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the horizon audit lists each exposure. A farm running 99 keys as a result burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. An attester must stake 47% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
